newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-So Minn hogs-Tuesday estimate 110,000 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-So Minn hogs-Tuesday estimate 110,000 - USDA.

text.p: Tuesday's estimate for interior Iowa and southern Minnesota hog receipts was 110,000 head, compared with 110,000 a week ago and 108,000 a year ago.
Estimates include generally about 60 percent Carcass Base Hogs. Barrows and gilts sold $0.50 per cwt higher than midsession Monday. Trade was moderate for good demand and light to moderate offerings.
Sows: under 500 steady-up 2.00, 500-up steady to 2.00 lower. US 1-3 300-450 lbs. 43.00 -46.00 44.00 -46.00

Note: Prices quoted represent sales of hogs averaging 73-74 pct. carcass yields with mostly 1.00-1.25 inches of last rib backfat and 47-48 pct. lean. Special considerations and grade premiums not reflected in base prices.
